Maintainer.Profile: IPTV Gateway: curate your IPTV providers once and use the line-up on every box. It merges Xtream Codes / M3U sources into bouquets with their own logins, cleans channel names, builds a better EPG (with optional extra XMLTV sources) and passes catch-up through. It serves them as an Xtream portal, M3U/XMLTV and an HDHomeRun tuner for Plex. It is a single lightweight native binary, and video goes straight from the provider to the box by default. It contains no content: bring your own legitimate sources.
